name: FishTank
summary: Security tools and protection, included with Aquarium.
description: FishTank is the Security app. The complete Aquarium bundle includes it; published Windows preview packages are also available from KailanBess/FishTank.

name: FishBowl
summary: Your emulators, games, and saves, organized together. Optional install.
description: FishBowl is the Emulation app. Install its Windows package from public GitHub releases. Bring your own games and emulators; none are downloaded with FishBowl.

name: FishNet
summary: Local media and linked app collections, included with Aquarium.
description: FishNet is the Media app. It is included in the complete Aquarium bundle. Browsers are added externally; there is no built-in browser. Future published releases can be installed through Aquarium.

name: File Organizer
summary: Preview renames and moves, compare duplicates and review recovery records.
description: Optional Aquarium tool. Reviews file changes, refuses overwrites, retains session undo and records source/destination paths for recovery. Recovery records are not file-content backups.

name: Device Inventory
summary: Track warranty, maintenance, serial numbers and receipt links.
description: Optional Aquarium tool with local device records. Receipt files remain external. Its settings and records can be backed up through Aquarium Recovery.

name: Workspace Launcher
summary: Save desktop app groups and review their window layouts before opening.
description: Optional Aquarium tool. Starts reviewed desktop executables and positions their windows. Missing apps are reported separately, and arbitrary command lines are not stored.

name: System Monitor
summary: Read-only CPU, memory and process observations with explicit unknown readings.
description: Optional standalone Windows utility. Samples while open, supports pause/filter/sort and an explicitly reviewed local snapshot export. It changes no process settings and does not measure GPU, disk/network rates, temperature or power consumption.

name: System Center
summary: Local OS, physical-memory and account-visible service observations.
description: Optional independent Windows utility. Refreshes read-only observations manually and explicitly exports reviewed JSON. Missing permissions stay unavailable; service states are not health or security verdicts. Drivers, repair and service controls are not provided.
